content: Implemented workspace bar in lua/bar/init.lua; tests run init.lua in wasmoon (Lua 5.4) against SDK MockHost 4f9f1ba7; 36 tests incl. per-column Core workspaceline parity; just check green. Host gaps: no band click routing in Core, fg/bg/bold not painted, no exclusive zone, empty band keeps stacking index, mounts activation-only.

PR bar#2 merged as 558271bb (squash, --admin per owner). CI Quality gates green. CodeRabbit is not installed on plugin repos (no bot comments on bar#2 or prior plugin PRs), nothing to apply. Issue #1 closed. No independent reviewer dispatched by this subagent (harness rule); commander to review post-merge.

Registry pin: not changed. origin/main bitty-plugins pins official plugins as submodules and has no bar entry (no registry/official/bar.toml, no plugins/bar gitlink), so there is no pin to bump; adding bar is full onboarding (capability review by a reviewer, docs page-set alignment, registry entry + manifest_hash, submodule) and collides with the uncommitted local registry-pins.toml submodule-removal migration in the bitty-plugins checkout. Follow-up for the bitty-plugins commander.

Post-merge review bar#2 (558271bb) by bar-reviewer: NEEDS-FIX. Blocker (confirmed): truncate_chars gmatch pattern with lone bytes 128-191 raises invalid utf-8 on phodopus (pattern.to_str in stdlib/string/patterns.rs, rev 1653c51f), so the bar cannot render on the real host; rewrite with string.byte/string.sub. Also: tests run wasmoon Lua 5.4 not phodopus (add phodopus gate); args_schema id should be integer (non-blocking); merged with no review/CodeRabbit output. Parity model, manifest, SDK surface, supply chain, hardcoded values OK. Review doc: recording/semantic-review/2026-10-02-170042-bar-pr-2.md

Fix implemented: M.segments uses row.id (stable seq) instead of index; README and code comment updated to stable-id; reference model core-workspaceline.ts now renders slot.seq with seq carried from row.id; bar.test.ts expectations updated to stable labels plus new close-first/close-middle stable-seq test. Gates: bun test 37 pass; just check green. Negative control: old index code fails 10/37, fixed passes 37/37.

R1 merged: bar pill labels stable-seq (PR #3 -> e97071f); 37/37 tests; APPROVE. Core bar deletion unblocked on R2 surface.

Surface verified at bitty d749571e (read-only): WorkspaceInfo gains scratchpad_count 0/1 (clamped via SCRATCHPAD_COUNT_MAX) + scratchpad_occupied, marshalled in workspace_list_value under workspace.read; window-global identical on every row; put/take fires existing workspace.changed. No new event, grant, or panel capability. No surface-shape concern.
